fields.position: Keep the optimization objective unchanged. Partition trajectory entropy by verifier outcome, validity, and solution mode, then use same-prefix covariance to explain the direction of local changes.
fields.tradeoff: The exact decomposition needs deterministic partitions. Local covariance does not identify strategy modes or causal attribution. The CPU implementation covers the numerical kernel, not the multi-objective RLVR matrix.

fields.summary: Added RCEA to separate policy optimization from entropy diagnostics. Falling global entropy does not establish that valid strategies contracted. The local component verifies only the trajectory chain rule and first-order local approximation.
